title: fix(examples): showcase record write actions write as the caller instead of through an elevated script body
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu7ZZBnHrYcv5pDjzwJhi4K3)_

Fixes #25468

## Summary

Three showcase record actions — **Mark Done** (`showcase_mark_done`), **Reopen** (`showcase_reopen_task`) and **Submit for Sign-off** (`showcase_submit_signoff`) — set fields on their own record and nothing else, but they did it from a script body whose `ctx.api` runs with the system identity (`buildActionExecutionContext` stamps `isSystem: true`). So the write did not carry the caller's object, row or field permissions.

Each one now **declares** the write (`operation: 'update'` + `patch`, spec #14092, server #15079), and the platform action route performs it **as the caller**. Object CRUD, RLS, FLS, hooks and validation all apply, exactly as for a `PATCH` of the same row. A caller who may edit the record uses the button as before; a caller who may not gets the same `403` the data plane gives, and nothing is written.

**Ruled by Sales: B** (ruling record 6384686314 on #25468, Sales verbatim 「25468 B」). This departs from the triage grading 6369139790, which prescribed `requiredPermissions` (ADR-0066 D4); the departure is Sales's ruling. Under that route the three actions would have been usable by nobody on a fresh boot, admins included: admins hold no package capability, neither gate has an admin bypass, and no provisioned showcase user holds `showcase_contributor`. The declared write itself is the maintainer's 2026-09-01 ruling on #14092 (5494341350, 「同意」), with #14010's 5494343943: the write runs as the caller, never system-elevated.

## What changed

- `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/index.ts`
  - `showcase_mark_done`: `patch: { done: true, progress: 100 }`, `execution: 'perRecord'`; body removed.
  - `showcase_reopen_task`: `patch: { done: false }`, `execution: 'perRecord'`; body removed. The guard hook `showcase_guard_task_reopen` still refuses the reopening write with its sentence — now it refuses the caller's own update.
  - `showcase_submit_signoff`: `patch: { status: 'sent' }`; body removed.
  - Labels, icons, `successMessage`, `visible`, `locations` and `refreshAfter` are unchanged. `type` stays `'script'` (the schema default for a declared write).
  - The docblocks say which rule the showcase models: an action that only sets fields on its record declares the write; a script body that writes gates itself with `requiredPermissions` (ADR-0066 D4).
- `examples/app-showcase/src/data/hooks/index.ts`, `src/ui/views/task.view.ts`: comments only.
- `examples/app-showcase/test/actions.test.ts`: the executability sweep accepts a declared write; the #2169 handler regression now iterates the actions that still have a body; a new pin asserts that **no action body writes without a capability gate**, and that the declared writes are exactly these three.
- `examples/app-showcase/test/task-reopen-hook-refusal.test.ts`: half 2 now pins the declared write (`operation: 'update'`, `patch: { done: false }`, no body).
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-record-write-actions.dogfood.test.ts` (new): over real HTTP on the stock showcase, each refusal is paired with the data plane's own answer for the same caller and row, and with an allow for a caller who may edit.

## Platform checklist (a `domain:devx` touch, declared)

Two items named these actions' script bodies and are respelled, with `revision` bumped and a `history` row each:

- `api-backend.packaged-action-disabled-dispatch` (rev 7): Mark Done is described as a declared write. While measuring it, the same boot answered the **enabled** control on a nonexistent record id `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`, which falsified the item's "the enabled control CANNOT 404". Every door already consumes the caller-scope load's verdict (`refuseDeniedSubjectLoad`), the script door included, so the text was stale before this change too. `knownGaps[1]` and `acceptance[2]` are respelled; `acceptance[2]` still scores from the disabled traces alone.
- `records-forms.script-action-hook-refusal-toast` (rev 3): Reopen is described as a declared write. The two source rows for the nested action-VM hop leave, replaced by the route's catch and the new dogfood pin. The observable answer is unchanged: measured, the admin's Reopen still answers `400 VALIDATION_ERROR` carrying `TASK_REOPEN_REFUSAL`. The console dispatches an `operation: 'update'` action through the same registered script handler (objectui `ActionRunner.executeUpdateOperation` at the `.objectui-sha` pin `6fb31dc`), so the toast chain the item observes is the same.

`pnpm check:platform-checklist` is green on `b829a362`.

## Tests

All on the merged head `b829a362` (this branch plus `origin/main` `49653f91`), unless noted:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase test`: **39 files, 484 tests passed**; `tsc --noEmit` exit 0.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-record-write-actions.dogfood.test.ts`: **7/7 passed** (run under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`); dogfood `tsc --noEmit` exit 0.
- **Ablation** (run on the pre-merge head and again on `b829a362`): with `examples/app-showcase/src/ui/actions/index.ts` restored from `origin/main` (bodies back), exactly the **3 refusal pins go red** (the action route no longer answers as the data plane does) and the 4 allow pins stay green. The file was then restored with `git checkout HEAD -- path`, and `git status --porcelain` was empty.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the six changed source/test files: exit 0.

## Gates

On the pre-merge head `3027e0a3` (the merge brings no change to this diff's files), `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 63 commands for this file surface; all 63 ran with exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles **63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN**. Two first answered exit 3 (a prerequisite, not a verdict) and were rerun after it was met: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (its pinned fixture commit was missing from the shallow clone; fetched) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (seven unbuilt dists; built). Dogfood battery: n/a (no `!` in the title, no narrowing arm).

## Declarations

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

- No changeset: `@objectstack/example-showcase` is `private: true` and publishes nothing (`skip-changeset`).
- Branch `claude/project-thread-z0wf71` is the harness-pinned branch for this session and names no issue; the claim comment 6372266664 on #25468 is the identity record (services seat 1, `session_01SGzB5Np4fydLKpGjZm1dNr`).
- Not `packages/**` code, not objectui. A hint that hides the button from a caller who may not edit is a console follow-up the triage explicitly kept out; today such a caller still sees the button and gets a `403` toast when they click it.

## Acceptance notes

- `showcase_portfolio_snapshot` keeps its body. It reads (`capabilities: ['api.read']`), is `ai.exposed`, and declares no `requiredPermissions`, so its counts of accounts, projects and invoices are computed with the system identity for any signed-in caller, including one who cannot read invoices. It writes nothing, and it was outside this card's grading (write actions only). Noted for the seat to judge; carrier: none.
- The record-load staleness in `api-backend.packaged-action-disabled-dispatch` described above predates this change; it is fixed here because this PR edits that item.
